name: so101-policy
description: Run a trained LeRobot 0.6.1 policy (ACT or SmolVLA) on an SO-101 follower arm with one USB camera. Loads a pinned Hugging Face model revision and stops safely: back to the start pose, then torque off.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Port for the policy runner's web page (status, Start and Stop): open http://<device>:<port> in a browser

variables.name: FOLLOWER_SERIAL_DEVICE
variables.description: USB serial tty of the follower arm, such as ttyACM0. Check with ls -l /dev/serial/by-id/ on the device. It must be connected when you deploy.

variables.name: CALIBRATION_VOLUME
variables.description: Persistent volume that holds follower.json from the so101-calibration template: <calibration-app-id>-data
